pr_title: lib: acpi: fix for build error when acpi not enabled
pr_body:
Fix for acpi.h header file generates invalid C-code when CONFIG_ACPI=n

Fixes #68467

issue_context.title: ACPI: acpi.h header file generates invalid C-code when CONFIG_ACPI=n

review_comments:
What do you do if `res->Data.ExtendedIrq.InterruptCount` is greater than `CONFIG_ACPI_IRQ_VECTOR_MAX`? Don't you get a buffer overrun in that case?

I think the simple solution (which wouldn't require API changes) would be for the caller to pass the array size through the initial values of `irq_vector_max` and `mmio_max` and then upon return these would contain the actual number of fetched elements.

This is fine, but you're also missing the update of `irq_res->irq_vector_max` before returning from the function (to indicate how many entries were actually filled in). Maybe the variable should be `irq_vector_count`, since it's only a maximum when calling the function, but the actual count when returning.
it is already taken care (irq_res->irq_vector_max = res->Data.ExtendedIrq.InterruptCount) . Actual count is same as res->Data.ExtendedIrq.InterruptCount
